changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generated_report ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, company_id BIGINT, type VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(32), description VARCHAR(1024), file_path VARCHAR(1024), expires_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, updated_by BIGINT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generated_report_company_id ON generated_report (company_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generated_report_expires_at ON generated_report (expires_at);
